basic_info.description: NEW Pricing! MUST SEE! This building comprises of two full 5-room residential flats over a small ground floor bonus office space. Mid-Century charm. Both flats are 2BD/1BA, with one kitchen updated, fire places and double-paned windows. Bathrooms are tiled with bathtubs & separate stall showers. Ground floor bonus space is ideal for a professional home office or small business. 1 car garage. All units are tenant occupied and month-to-month. Building updates include circuit breakers & a new water heater for Unit 2337 installed in October of 2024. The building front and back was also newly painted in May of 2024. Close proximity to the N-Judah line. 1-block to Irving St shops & restaurants. 2-blocks to Golden Gate Park. Nearby to Ocean Beach and Freeways. Perfect for an owner/user or investor who wants street visibility for a small business. *Seller plans to raise rents, per SF Rent Board allowable rent increase, in April of 2025.*
